system.roleplaying: You have thoroughly studied your own powers and are proud of your mastery of them. You understand a good deal about the metaphysics of your powers.

greenAbility.name: Principle of Mastery
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome in a situation that uses your powers in a new way and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
